sustituye.Can I finance a custom pool project in F: Yes. We connect Florida homeowners with lending partners, and the order matters: you get your design and a fixed project price in writing first, and only then review how to pay for it. Approval and terms come from the lender.

anade.pregunta: How much does a custom pool cost in North Florida?
anade.respuesta: There is no single number: a custom pool is priced from its own design, size, finishes and site conditions. Our estimator walks you through the choices that move the price, and you get a fixed project price in writing before you commit.

anade.pregunta: Who pulls the permits for a pool in Florida?
anade.respuesta: We do. Permitting and code compliance are part of the build: we prepare the submittal, pull the permits and coordinate the county inspections through to final start-up.

anade.pregunta: What is included in a custom pool project?
anade.respuesta: Design and 3D rendering, engineering, permitting, excavation, the gunite shell, plumbing and circulation, electrical and equipment, interior finish, tile and coping, the deck, and final start-up.
